text:
jordan-sales: Heads up — NovaHealth demo just hit a streaming parse failure during a live walkthrough. Browser console: "Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input" when trying to parse streamed chat. Anyone seen intermittent truncated SSE chunks? :grimacing:

alex-eng: thanks — can you paste the raw network payload (DevTools -> Network -> response) or server logs? Also the request_id if available.

jordan-sales: pasted Request ID: req_0a7b9c. Browser fetch stack: Error: Unexpected end of JSON input at JSON.parse (<anonymous>).

jordan-sales: network response snippet (copied from Network tab):
```http
data: {"id":"msg_1","role":"assistant","content":"Hello, starting long reply that gets cut"


data: {"id":"msg_1","role":"assistant","content":" continued and finished"}

```

maria-solutions: that looks like two separate SSE events where the first event's data is an incomplete JSON object and the second closes it. Could be a client-side reassembly bug or the corporate proxy is coalescing/chopping frames.

sam-ops: any CDN/proxy between them and our API? Corporate proxies (Zscaler, BlueCoat) often buffer and will merge or drop chunk boundaries. Can you ask them to try a direct connection (cell hotspot) or run curl with no-buffer?

jordan-sales: customer confirms they're on Zscaler for corp wifi. They said it works on phone sometimes but flaky on corp wifi.

alex-eng: likely proxy buffering. Quick repro command for them to run locally (we ask them to paste output):
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=gpt-q&stream=true" -o -
```
Use -N to disable curl's buffering. If curl shows proper line-delimited event chunks it's probably their proxy. If curl still shows merged/truncated JSON, we need the full tcpdump or request_id.

sam-ops: also check response headers: `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, and any `X-Accel-Buffering`/nginx buffering settings in front of them. If an intermediate proxy inserts buffering headers that's the clue.

maria-solutions: immediate workaround: fall back to non-streaming for the demo (stream=false) or implement a small incremental parser on the client that buffers until a newline-delimited event completes before JSON.parse. I'll add this to the POC playbook.

jordan-sales: I sent curl + request_id to their infra team; they tried disabling Zscaler HTTP buffering in their policy for our host and staging started working. They will test tomorrow in production. Thanks everyone. :tada:

ingress-bot: Deploy v1.42 to streaming-rs finished 14m ago — no infra alerts detected.

jordan-sales: confirmed: customer disabling Zscaler buffering fixed the fragmentation in staging. We'll keep streaming off for the customer demo if they can't disable on prod.

alex-eng: great. If they can't change proxy settings, we can offer dedicated gateway/Private option to terminate streams inside their network, or recommend using non-streaming responses for critical demos.

maria-solutions: adding note to the security questionnaire / enterprise blockers doc: "Enterprise HTTP proxies may interfere with SSE chunk boundaries — recommend validating proxy buffering settings, using non-streaming fallback, or deploying a dedicated gateway."
